unembedding_space: raw cosine between V[:,sv] and lm_head.weight[token]
candidate_naming: LXX_SVYY where layer is 0-based and SV rank is 1-based

notes.mean_abs_cosine: mean(|a| / ||h||); useful for cross-layer scale normalization
notes.top1_abs_rate: fraction of tokens where this SV has the largest |a| among the top-k bank
notes.top5_abs_rate: fraction of tokens where this SV is among the r largest |a| in the top-k bank
notes.std_activation: variation across token activations; useful for spotting nearly constant/baseline directions
notes.robust_activation_scale: 1.4826 * MAD from the bounded cross-corpus token sample; falls back to ordinary std if MAD is zero
notes.stable_excess_kurtosis: exact streaming fourth-central-moment tail weight; high values may indicate selectivity or artifacts
notes.effective_support_fraction: M2^2 / (N*M4); smaller means activation energy is supported by fewer tokens
notes.positive/negative_top0_1pct_energy_share: share of one-sided squared robust-z energy in the strongest 0.1% of sampled tokens
notes.positive/negative_doc_count_z5: number of documents whose exact polarity-specific peak exceeds robust z=5
notes.tail_selectivity_score: max over polarities of q999_z * sqrt(top0.1pct_energy_share) * min(1, (doc_z5_count+1)/(min_tail_docs+1)); the pseudocount retains unsupported shapes but downweights them
notes.selected_tail_top_context_largest_center: lexical concentration among retained extreme events; high values flag token-specific candidates
notes.nearest_unembed_cosine: largest cosine between the unit SV direction and any unembedding row
notes.farthest_unembed_cosine: most negative cosine between the unit SV direction and any unembedding row
notes.max_abs_unembed_token_cosine: max absolute token cosine; a rough token-likeness / lexical anchoring score
